verdict.rationale: Mintlify's first-party docs explicitly offer running Mintlify inside your own cloud or on-premises environment, on AWS or any Kubernetes platform (Azure, Google Cloud, Oracle Cloud, OpenShift). A community comment calling it "pure SaaS" is a general opinion from an older thread, not a concrete report that self-hosting fails, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. The product is also source-available rather than open source. Missing for 10: detailed self-host documentation beyond a one-line summary (requirements, feature parity, licensing or plan tier), independent or hands-on corroboration that self-hosted deployments work.
